name: commit0

stage_A.cells: TWIN (N=50), BAN, X_b (b in 0-11, 12-23, 24-35, 0-35; block outputs at task-spec positions <- the full ban's), COND (twin prefill, then K/V of the condition span in all layers <- the ban's = route arm d), RPOS (read position, all 36 blocks <- the ban's), MR_0-35 and MR_12-23 on T03/T10/T2 (h <- h_twin + ||h_src - h_twin|| u, fresh unit u per (slot, l, p)), PLACEBO on T03/T10/T2 (source = a second neutral twin, band 0-35); N = 30 on slots 0-29
stage_A.transfer: share(label == Y | cell) - share(label == Y | TWIN), all samples (invalid rows count as not-Y)
stage_A.recovery: transfer / (Y_BAN - Y_TWIN), reported only if the denominator >= 0.3
stage_A.tests: exact McNemar on paired slots (event = label == Y): X vs TWIN and X_0-35 vs MR_0-35; Holm across tasks within each family
stage_A.P1_prediction: transfer >= 0.5 at band 0-35 with pass ratio >= 0.8 on at least 2 of T2, T03, T10, AND transfer <= 0.2 on T05 and T06 (reported with its 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound)
stage_A.route_check_secondary: COND transfer >= 0.5 on T05 and T06 and <= 0.2 on T2; RPOS transfer <= 0.2 everywhere
stage_A.MR_prediction: X_0-35 beats MR_0-35 on Y (exact McNemar p < 0.05) wherever P1 transfers

ST.unit: ban-free n[l,p] = ||h_twin[l,p]|| * r_Q(l) (exp23 qwen_ratio, exp27 interpolation), bf16 twin states
ST.S1E: target at R = alpha * sqrt(sum_spec n[l,p]^2) (S0's energy at block l)
ST.S2E: target per cond position = alpha * sqrt(sum_spec n^2 / sum_cond n^2) * n[l,c]
ST.S3: generated tokens 1-32, blocks 12-23, target alpha * mean_spec n[l,p], teacher-forced twin shadow rows
ST.edit: displacement-targeted: delta = h - h_clean; h <- h + (alpha*n - delta.u) u; one fresh direction per sample from dir_seed(task, site, alpha, slot)
ST.outcome: 1 = passes the hidden tests AND label not in {default, other, invalid}; sensitivity: correct 'other' counts as 1
ST.design: prefill sites only (S0 reference, S4, S5, S1, S2, S1E = S1 + energy dummy, S2E = S2 + energy dummy) + log D_R + log D_g1 (ban-free units at block 35, offset 1e-3); RCS(3) in log D_R as sensitivity; common-support trimming to the 2.5-97.5 percentile overlap of log D_R
ST.estimator: Firth bias-reduced logistic (numpy), profile-penalised CI + 2,000-resample cluster bootstrap over CRN slots (percentile); Mantel-Haenszel OR S0 vs S1, S0 vs S2 within quintiles of log D_R
ST.RULE: the prefill-site claim SURVIVES iff, on >= 1 of T03 and T10, beta_S1 < 0 and beta_S2 < 0 with the cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of each excluding 0 and the profile CI agreeing in sign; otherwise it is WITHDRAWN as FP8-specific. If S0 has 0 correct off-default programs at every alpha on both tasks, the verdict is 'no prefill site moves the algorithm in bf16' (withdrawn).

state_vs_token.K_S3: mean over tokens 1-32 of KL(S3 || teacher-forced twin shadow) per sample, mean over the 50 S3 samples
state_vs_token.DMD: temperature on generated tokens 1-32 only (T = 1 after), bisected until the on-policy mean per-token KL is within 10% of K_S3 (cap T = 3.0; flagged if not reached); amendment commit #2 before the DMD samples
state_vs_token.flip: arm correct and non-default while the twin's slot is default
state_vs_token.test: exact McNemar on discordant flips S3-only vs DMD-only; threshold p < 0.05 on both tasks at alpha 2 (primary; alpha 4 secondary); minimum detectable: 6:0 discordant (p = 0.031)

top5_push.unit: bf16 nS[l,p] = mean over templates of ||h_ban - h_twin|| at spec positions, blocks 12-23
top5_push.geometry: spec-mean block outputs (blocks 12-23) / exp20 med_norm projected on the PCA plane of the 10 forced-prompt centroids (actual activation coordinates) + geodesic k-NN MDS
top5_push.landing_test: landing-weighted geodesic distance to the nearest banned centroid vs a random-survivor null (1,000 draws); 'not computable' with < 5 correct non-default programs

L.events: push-landing events from exp22 escape_9task (FP8), exp25 extra_arm_a + panel A, exp26 panel B, exp28 Gemma; one row per event: task, engine, default, landing composition, base runner-up, q_base, twin non-default composition (event table frozen in commit #1 before any opening pass)
L.forecasts: BASE = q_base + 1; TWINMIN = twin non-default counts + 1 (undefined if empty); OPEN = p ~ exp(open[alg]) with open = logmeanexp over >= 3 programs of the summed log-prob of the first 48 program tokens, averaged over twin templates; sensitivity p ~ 1/rank; each mixed with 5% uniform, 'other' floored at 2%
L.primary: exact one-sided sign test (BASE > OPEN) on events where BASE top-1 != OPEN top-1 and exactly one hits; minimum 5 of 5 (p = 0.031) published before scoring
L.secondary: Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-event log-score differences; BASE vs TWINMIN

rules.analysis_code: frozen in amendment commit 'analysis_code' before any headline is computed (deviation D-AC)

drop_order: forced sources beyond T2 and T10
never_drop: ST alpha 1-4 on T03/T10 + indicator model
Stage A bands on T2 T03 T10 T1 T05 T06
